Class EmployeeController

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.controller.EmployeeController
public class EmployeeController extends Object
Controller for the manager's Employees screen (employee-view.fxml). Lists every visible employee, registers new employees from a single form, saves edits made directly in the table, and removes (hides) employees.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded. Sets up the table columns and their in-place editing (username stays read-only), fills the role choices, connects the buttons and the username suggestion, and starts loading the employee list.

    • loadEmployees

      private void loadEmployees()
      Loads every visible employee in the background and shows them in the table. The status label reports progress, the number loaded, or the error.

    • withEdits

      private User withEdits(User user, String firstName, String lastName, String username, String role)
      Copies a user with new name, username and role values. The id, store, password hash and timestamps are kept from the original.
      Parameters:
      user - the employee being edited
      firstName - new first name; may be null
      lastName - new last name
      username - new username
      role - new role, manager or cashier
      Returns:
      a new User with the given values; user is not changed

    • saveEdit

      private void saveEdit(User original, User updated)
      Saves a table edit in the background. On success the row is replaced with the saved employee; on failure the table is refreshed so the cell shows its previous value again, and the error is shown in the status label.
      Parameters:
      original - the employee as currently shown in the table
      updated - the employee with the edited values to save

    • removeEmployee

      private void removeEmployee()
      Removes the selected employee in the background. The employee is hidden rather than deleted, so past orders still point at them. Does nothing if no row is selected.

    • addEmployee

      private void addEmployee()
      Registers a new employee from the form in the background. The username is lowercased before saving. The Add button is disabled while saving so the employee can't be added twice. On success the employee is added to the top of the table and the form is cleared; on failure the form keeps its values and the error (for example, a taken username) is shown in the status label.

    • clearForm

      private void clearForm()
      Empties every field of the new-employee form, resets the role to cashier, and moves focus to the first name field.

    • suggestUsername

      private void suggestUsername()
      Fills the username field with the first initial plus the last name, in lowercase with anything other than letters and digits removed (for example, Alicia Nguyen becomes anguyen). Runs whenever the first or last name changes. Leaves the field alone if the manager has typed their own username, and clears it while either name is empty.
